01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE QUERIES

A little about me.

Curiosity is where analysis begins. Structure and storytelling are how I make it useful.

I'm Rohit Kumar, a BCA Data Science student at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, expected to graduate in 2027. My current SGPA is 9.39 / 10.

My work so far has included cleaning and exploring datasets, writing SQL queries, building dashboards, and developing analytical projects across e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, and road safety.

I like the full analytical process: asking the right question, preparing reliable data, exploring what is happening, and communicating the result in a way people can act on. I'm continuing to strengthen my practical skills through projects and internships.
